text:
A wire has a uniform circular cross-sectional area.
Which statement is correct?
A
The resistance of the wire is directly proportional to its cross-sectional area and inversely
proportional to its diameter.
B
The resistance of the wire is directly proportional to its cross-sectional area and inversely
proportional to its length.
C
The resistance of the wire is directly proportional to its length and inversely proportional to its
cross-sectional area.
D
The resistance of the wire is directly proportional to its length and inversely proportional to its
diameter.
